subject: Re: Project Obsidian kickoff — Cluster-GCN on our entity graphs
body:
Obsidian status.

Reproduction: green on both benchmarks. PPI micro-F1 matches the published Cluster-GCN result within noise, Reddit likewise — and the headline property holds: peak GPU memory stays flat as we scale batch count, exactly what the cluster-induced subgraph batching promises. A 5-layer model on Reddit trains on a single A100 where full-batch would OOM.

Internal graph (Csilla): first METIS partitioning of the entity graph done — 1,400 partitions, partition quality looks reasonable (6.2% edge cut). First training runs this week.

Risk to flag: our entity graph's degree distribution is much more skewed than Reddit's. A handful of hub nodes end up with most of their edges cut across partitions, which the paper's stochastic multiple-partition trick mitigates but maybe not fully at our skew. Wei is designing an ablation; if hub-node accuracy lags we may need a hybrid batching scheme for the top 0.1% of nodes.

Efe
